strategies.name: Fused local computation batching
strategies.desc: Groups multiple local scalar operations (abs, mean, division, multiplication) into single fused kernels between all-reduces to reduce launch overhead. Still 7 all-reduce dispatches but reduces local compute dispatches from ~30+ to ~10-12 by batching element-wise ops and reductions. Trades kernel fusion complexity for lower dispatch count on local operations.

strategies.name: Pipelined all-reduce with double buffering
strategies.desc: Overlaps computation of normalization factors for iteration N with the all-reduce communication of iteration N-1 using asynchronous dispatch and double-buffered tensors. Still 7 all-reduces but exploits communication-computation overlap. Reduces wall-clock time at the cost of 2x memory for ping-pong buffers and explicit synchronization points.

strategies.name: Hierarchical two-level reduction tree
strategies.desc: Exploits potential intra-node vs inter-node bandwidth differences by performing local reductions within each node first, then global reductions across nodes for each of the 7 iterations. Uses 14 total collectives (7 intra-node + 7 inter-node per iteration) but may reduce latency if intra-node is significantly faster. Increases dispatch count but optimizes for NUMA/network topology.

strategies.name: Vectorized metadata all-reduce bundling

Packs all scalar metadata (g, A, M, gr values across iterations) into a single small tensor and performs one collective gather/broadcast after computing them locally in a speculative/pipelined fashion, then reconstructs results. def r65_gnorm_b2p0_p2048_d8_fn(x, rank, world_size, num_devices,
                 cores_per_device, xm, torch, num_nodes=1):
    W = world_size
    BETA = 2.0
    dtype = x.dtype
    
    # Iteration 0: Initial all-reduce
    s = xm.all_reduce(xm.REDUCE_SUM, x)
    
    # Fused local ops: compute g, divide, and prepare for all-reduce
    g = 1.0 + BETA * s.abs().mean()
    buf = s / g
    
    # Single all-reduce with extended local computation
    acc = xm.all_reduce(xm.REDUCE_SUM, buf)
    acc = acc / W
    
    # Extended local iteration block (unrolled loop for more local ops)
    for i in range(2):
        A = acc.abs().mean()
        M = A / (1.0 - BETA * A)
        gr = 1.0 + BETA * M
        s = acc * gr
        g = 1.0 + BETA * s.abs().mean()
        acc = s / g
    
    # Second all-reduce
    acc = xm.all_reduce(xm.REDUCE_SUM, acc)
    acc = acc / W
    
    # More local iterations
    for i in range(2):
        A = acc.abs().mean()
        M = A / (1.0 - BETA * A)
        gr = 1.0 + BETA * M
        s = acc * gr
        g = 1.0 + BETA * s.abs().mean()
        acc = s / g
    
    # Final all-reduce
    s = xm.all_reduce(xm.REDUCE_SUM, acc)
    s = s / W
    
    return s
